issue_context.title: Somfy Covers wrongly assumed to have the capability of "position"
issue_context.body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST:
  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/
  - Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/releases
  - Do not report issues for integrations if you are using custom components or integrations.
  - Provide as many details as possible. Paste logs, configuration samples and code into the backticks.
  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->
Three of my somfy controlled covers were not detected. The stacktrace below shows the probable cause of this.
These covers are actually not using the somfy internal motors but have been upgraded with switches (like e.g. https://www.somfy.de/produkte/1811404/smoove-uno-a-m-io-pure). Those switches thus won't be able report the position of the motor since they simply do not know it.

When looking into the Somfy API you may find that both systems may report the capability "position". However the device returns an empty array for the "states" property. Another way of distinguishing them would be to use the type attribute, however I have no idea whether there is a full list of possible "type" values to use.

## Environment
- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.118.2
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): unknown
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): HassOS 4.16
- Integration causing this issue: Somfy
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/somfy/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
# Configure a default setup of Home Assistant (frontend, api, etc)
default_config:

# Text to speech
tts:
  - platform: google_translate

group: !include groups.yaml
automation: !include automations.yaml
script: !include scripts.yaml
scene: !include scenes.yaml
```

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
2020-11-21 10:31:51 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.cover] Error adding entities for domain cover with platform somfy
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 423, in _async_add_entity
    supported_features=entity.supported_features,
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/cover/__init__.py", line 219, in supported_features
    if self.current_cover_position is not None:
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/somfy/cover.py", line 110, in current_cover_position
    position = 100 - self.cover.get_position()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/pymfy/api/devices/roller_shutter.py", line 11, in get_position
    return cast(int, self.get_state("position"))
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/pymfy/api/devices/base.py", line 34, in get_state
    return next(
StopIteration

The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 316, in async_add_entities
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
RuntimeError: coroutine raised StopIteration
```

comments:
Hey there @tetienne, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`somfy`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L415) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Hi, I didn't fully understand what you did with your cover, but you find a bug I guess. What's surprise me is the fact this error is in this component since the beginning: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/somfy/cover.py#L109
I checked the presence or not of the position capability. That's wrong, I must check the states array... Until now, if a device was able to set its position, it was able to return it. It's not anymore the case.
I will have some times to fix this Monday.

For myself, refined supported features: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/cover/__init__.py#L215

@tetienne: The regular case would be to have a smart motor that knows the exact position. However Somfy also allows to upgrade existing regular (meaning not smart) 230V motors by having a switch that gets remote controlled. These switches still allow to move the cover into a specific given position (like e.g. 80%). Afaik they do so by tracking the time it takes internally. However they sadly do not return this assumed position.
Thank you @matthiasBender for the explanation. The fix is done. Now, we have to wait for the release ;)
Wow, that was impressively fast. Thank you :)

review_comments: That looks like the better check to do here.
